newsitem.title: CANADA: Noranda Forest sees brighter '97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Noranda Forest sees brighter '97 profit.

text.p: Noranda Forest Inc said on Thursday that the forecast of higher pulp and paper prices will help boost the forest products company's earnings in 1997.
Noranda earlier reported a loss of C$0.16 per share in the fourth quarter ended December 31, compared to a profit of C$0.27 per share in the same period a year ago.
Earnings for the full year dropped to C$0.10 a share from C$1.32 per share in 1995.
"Forecast improvements in pulp and paper prices later in 1997 will strengthen earnings from their current level, more than offsetting weak OSB prices," Noranda said.
